run_train_sdxl_lpl: run the LPL training script for Stable Diffusion XL text-to-image finetuning with Latent Perceptual Loss
parse_args_sdxl_lpl: parse command-line arguments for the SDXL LPL training script including dataset, optimizer, and LPL loss options
